contract_revision.old: Incident plus how-to defaults to uncertain unless explicitly asking for rules.
contract_revision.new: Clear-topic how-to, query-method and incident guidance default to policy_question; unclear topic stays uncertain; explicit application and existing-case continuation stay case_action.
contract_revision.reason: Give sourced general help without a redundant clarification; only actual business handling requires explicit application and confirmation.

protocol.variable: Goal wording in the existing intent call; case taxonomy, fusion, confirmation and tool permissions unchanged

已签收就说明本人收到吗？我只是问这个规则。

api_ablation.baseline: Restore committed old intent method, General system prompt and General skill in an otherwise current runtime.
api_ablation.goal_only: Current intent method; restore old General system prompt and skill.
api_ablation.full: Current goal, General prompt and General skill.
semantic_acceptance: Use retrieved sources for known policy; state missing cancellation/after-dispatch policy explicitly.
No invented buttons, interception/rejection rules or after-dispatch eligibility.
Explain lookup methods without claiming a live result.
Unclear request clarifies; explicit case keeps materials and confirmation; refund status does not collect unusable fields.

protocol.stop: Five paired intent rounds and one eight-case API ablation per group; retain failures and do not retune these samples after results.
